view: Roman Carthage Antonine Baths ruins from low seaward-facing angle through roofless brick and stone lower service chambers, heavy vault fragments and one distant upright column, sea behind; no complete bathhouse reconstruction.

eras.title: Baths above the sea
eras.caption: The Antonine Baths faced the sea in Roman Carthage. Their surviving lower rooms and massive masonry show the scale of a public bath complex that once served one of the largest cities in the western Roman world.
